Ivy (People Ops): Mateo's passport name doesn't match his national registry. He's remote in Chile and says passport renewal is underway. Need a low-friction path so his Monday orientation isn't blocked.

Samir (HR): For Chile we accept: (A) recorded video + renewal receipt, (B) e-notary if available, or (C) consulate-certified copy within 7 days. Video + receipt is fine for provisional access.

Ivy (People Ops): Mateo, can you do a 6-minute Zoom recording tonight showing the passport and the renewal receipt? Also upload to the secure intake link.

Mateo (New Hire): I can do 7pm CLT. I'll show the passport on camera and read whatever script you need. Uploaded a PDF of the receipt here: https://files.redwood.com/receipts/mateo (placeholder).

Kai (IT): Heads-up: we can enable email and Slack for orientation but will hold laptop/badge until the document path is closed. VPN and corp SSO remain off. I can hold shipment 48hrs.

Samir (HR): Attestation script (copy/paste):

```
I, [Full Name], attest that the passport shown and the renewal receipt attached are authentic and belong to me. I consent to Redwood Inference recording and storing this verification for onboarding purposes.
```

Ivy (People Ops): Please fill the exception form: https://forms.redwood.com/i9-exception select 'intl-video-receipt'. We'll tag Onboard Exceptions as `cl-renewal-video`.

Onboard-Bot: BG case BG-40122 created. Status: docs-requested.

Mateo (New Hire): Done 44d I booked 7pm CLT and will upload the recording right after.

Ivy (People Ops): Plan: Zoom recording tonight, HR logs provisional, IT holds device, benefits enrollment deferred ~pay-cycle until verification. I'll confirm once recording uploaded. :white_check_mark:
